Nvidia CEO on AI Safety and Cutting Off Unsafe Customers

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that the company would cut off customers developing unsafe artificial intelligence, describing such a scenario as hypothetical but emphasizing the need for control and monitoring tools. He expressed support for UK safety research initiatives.
